name: Head circumference
landmark: Around head above eyebrows and ears at widest part of occiput

name: Neck circumference
landmark: Circumference at neck base directly above clavicles

name: Chest circumference
landmark: Horizontal circumference around fullest part of chest across shoulder blades

name: High bust
landmark: Circumference around torso directly under armpits, above bust mound

name: High bust front
landmark: Front arc from side seam to side seam across upper chest above bust

name: Bust front
landmark: Front arc between side seams across apex/fullest point of bust

name: Bust point to underbust
landmark: Vertical distance from bust apex down along curve to inframammary fold

name: Bust span
landmark: Horizontal distance between left and right bust points (apex to apex)

name: Underbust
landmark: Horizontal circumference directly beneath breasts along inframammary crease

name: HPS to bust
landmark: High Point Shoulder (neck-shoulder intersect) down to bust point

name: HPS to waist front
landmark: High Point Shoulder over bust apex down to front natural waistline

name: HPS to waist back
landmark: High Point Shoulder down across back curvature to back natural waistline

name: Shoulder slope
landmark: Angular or vertical drop from neck-shoulder intersection to outer acromion

name: Shoulder to shoulder
landmark: Horizontal cross-back distance between left and right acromion bone tips

name: Waist to armpit
landmark: Vertical distance along side seam from natural waist up to base of armpit

name: Waist to underbust
landmark: Vertical distance from front natural waistline up to underbust crease

name: Biceps circumference
landmark: Circumference at fullest horizontal point of upper arm between shoulder and elbow

name: Shoulder to elbow
landmark: Distance from shoulder acromion point down along arm to tip of olecranon (elbow)

name: Shoulder to wrist
landmark: Total arm length from shoulder tip over elbow to wrist styloid bone

name: Wrist circumference
landmark: Circumference taken over distal styloid processes of radius and ulna

name: Waist circumference
landmark: Horizontal circumference around narrowest torso level (natural waist)

name: Waist back
landmark: Back arc from side seam to side seam across back natural waistline

name: Waist to hips
landmark: Vertical distance from natural waistline down along side seam to high hip level

name: Waist to seat
landmark: Vertical distance from natural waistline down to level of fullest gluteal protrusion

name: Hips circumference
landmark: Circumference around pelvic rim (high hips) across iliac crests

name: Seat circumference
landmark: Full horizontal circumference around maximum projection of buttocks/gluteals

name: Seat back
landmark: Back contour arc between side seams across fullest point of seat

name: Crotch depth
landmark: Vertical distance from waistline down to level of perineal crotch line

name: Cross seam
landmark: Total crotch curve from center front waist down through perineum to center back waist

name: Cross seam front
landmark: Front crotch curve length from front center waistline to center crotch point

name: Inseam
landmark: Inside leg length from perineum/crotch fork along inner leg down to floor/ankle

name: Upper leg circumference
landmark: Circumference of thigh measured immediately below the gluteal fold

name: Waist to upper leg
landmark: Vertical distance from natural waist down to upper thigh circumference level

name: Knee circumference
landmark: Circumference horizontally around center of patella with leg extended

name: Waist to knee
landmark: Vertical distance along side seam from natural waist down to mid-patella level

name: Waist to floor
landmark: Vertical side length from natural waist down to floor without shoes

name: Ankle circumference
landmark: Circumference at narrowest point of lower leg directly above malleoli

name: Heel circumference
landmark: Diagonal circumference around back of calcaneus heel and front instep ankle crease
